decision: Selected the official federal building-address record EGAID 101087698 (Schorenweg 21, 4144 Arlesheim; EGID 2348834), served in WGS84 by api3.geo.admin.ch, as the project locator. NorthC publishes Schorenweg 21, 4144 Arlesheim as the address of its Münchenstein (Basel) 3 data centre on the uptownBasel campus.
identity_bridge: NorthC page 'Datacenter Münchenstein (Basel) 3': in the middle of the uptownBasel innovation campus; Adresse: Schorenweg 21, 4144 Arlesheim; total power 7.5 MW; available from 2027; designed for AI (GPU-ready, high density).
NorthC blog of 30 September 2026: a new AI enterprise data centre in Basel will open in 2027; the site menu lists Münchenstein (Basel) 3 among NorthC's Swiss data centres.
NorthC release of 11 September 2025: contract signed to build a regional data centre on the uptownBasel innovation campus in Arlesheim (new building, first phase 2,500 m2 and 6 MVA).
The federal search returns exactly one official address for Schorenweg 21 4144 Arlesheim, linked to EGAID 101087698 and GWR EGID 2348834.

consistency_checks.gwr_identify_600m_box: 63 GWR records in a 600 m box around the point; none carries a data-centre designation. The projected or permitted records (gstat 1001/1002) are Tramstrasse 64c (commercial building J5, about 311 m away), Schorenweg 12 (office and production building with bicycle shelters, about 240 m), two parking garages on campus parcel 6606 (about 190-203 m) and two unnamed projected buildings on parcel 6606 ('Gebäude 2' and 'Gewerbe- und Industriegebäude', class 1251, about 146-147 m) whose use is not stated, so either could be the new data-centre building (verifier correction, 23 October 2026). The new building is therefore not identifiable in the register and may lie up to about 150 m from the address point.

transform_check: The service serves the record in WGS84 (6 decimals) when asked for sr=4326; an independent pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1) EPSG:2056 to EPSG:4326 transform of the LV95 record differs by 0.04 m.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Recorded as a check (5.2 m from the selected point); the parcel is only 1,640 m2 and the new building's footprint is not published, so the official address point is kept.
A campus-wide point would be an industrial-zone style centroid; not used.

overlap_note: The register attaches Schorenweg 21 to an existing 1908 assembly hall (Montagehalle, 838 m2). NorthC describes the data centre as a new building; whether it replaces or adjoins that hall is not published.
